compatibility_dimensions.project-files: static-derived and extracted-execution expectations for the clip notes element read and written; reference execution not-run

expectation_provenance_labels.static-derived; not observed reference o: derived from evidence reviewed before sanitization
expectation_provenance_labels.extracted execution (x86_64 slice, glibc: the original program's x86_64 build computed the judged values on a Linux x86_64 host, with glibc in place of the macOS system libraries: the value limits and time-grid rounding applied to the value of the case's text, the reading of the text -0, and the saved text of the resulting value; locating the notes, reading other text, opening and saving remain static-derived

stated_assumptions: Opening a set and saving it without other changes changes the notes only as the release states; a refusal raised while the notes are read stops the reading of the document (as in midi-note-storage-v1).

Decimal number text is read and written with exact, correctly rounded conversions; exact decimal ties on save round to even (as in midi-note-storage-v1). No case lies on a tie. MNS-072 depends on the reading at full precision: a value one binary64 step below the nearest value to its text would be stored as 0.
The macOS arm64 build computes these limits, roundings, readings and texts as the x86_64 build does. All cases with the extracted-execution label depend on it.
The reference's decimal reading of -0 gives negative zero, as the glibc run did. MNS-073 depends on it; the results of MNS-074 are the same for either zero.
The reference's number text on save keeps the sign of negative zero, as the glibc run did. MNS-023 and MNS-073 depend on it.

inputs_without_expectation: a note without Time, Duration, Velocity or OffVelocity; NoteId absent from some but not all notes; an event without TimeOffset or Value
MidiKey outside 0 to 127, a key track without MidiKey, two key tracks with the same key, key tracks not in ascending key order, an empty key track, repeated key track or list Id values
notes of one key not in strictly ascending Time after rounding, or overlapping, beyond the not-refused outcome of REQ-MIDI-NOTE-STORAGE-010
a kept list with an event at or before offset 0 or at or after its note's Duration

NaN, infinite, # and hexadecimal number text, inf and nan words, leading whitespace other than U+0020; Invalid outside Duration and TimeOffset; magnitudes of 1,000,000 or more other than Invalid; negative zero read in VelocityDeviation, an event's TimeOffset or Value, or a curve control; saved values whose log10 is within 1e-12 of an integer without being an exact power of ten

integer text with spaces on both sides of the digits or a + with trailing spaces; a - sign; accepted integer values above 1,000,000; MidiKey, CC, list NoteId and Id text other than plain decimal (a leading - only in CC)
a missing structural element; unknown attributes or child elements in the note structures; a non-empty NoteProbabilityGroups
documents that break more than one refusal rule
other containers, envelopes, format versions and document kinds, including clip files
behavior: what is shown after a refusal and what remains open (REQ-MIDI-NOTE-STORAGE-017)
probability groups and the saved group next id (REQ-MIDI-NOTE-STORAGE-015)
key track and list Id values on save; whether empty key tracks are kept (REQ-MIDI-NOTE-STORAGE-012)
MIDI key range and repeated keys (REQ-MIDI-NOTE-STORAGE-011)
re-sorting, trimming or merging of unsorted or overlapping notes; adjustment of per-note lists at their note's edges
meaning of the values: time units, muting, chance, expression controllers
editing, playback, recording, undo; the rest of the clip and the set
